findings.title: `--pin`/`--repin` journal a pin they cannot store when the task has no candidate_sha, instead of refusing as PROTOCOL.md and the helper docstring both promise
new failure-injection tests overwrite the tracked `libexec/orchid-journal` in the repo under test with no EXIT-trap restore

`routing="$(... jobs review-plan --pin 2>&1)"` folds stderr into the slot table on the success path, so any diagnostic from a degraded read (e.g. a malformed engines.json reaching `ledger_available`'s unredirected jq) becomes a junk routing row the dispatch loop then walks
